widgets.title: Public-access boundary
widgets.source: Public routes are opt-in configuration. The collector never follows redirects, sends authentication headers, stores response bodies, edits DNS, opens firewall ports, or changes tunnel configuration.

widgets.title: Suggested review order
widgets.source:
1. Investigate unavailable local service checks.
  2. Renew certificates before the warning window.
  3. Confirm authentication and WebSocket behavior with a real client.
  4. Keep administration endpoints private.
